# Check keyboard behavior in the actual content control

The picker helper asserts autocomplete focus and typing a space after selecting zeta, guarding against cmd_space consumption. It separately opens/closes details through click, Space and Enter in the content window. Preserve these content-context assertions alongside popup checks. They are inspected test contracts; no live keyboard, accessibility tree or screen-reader run occurred here. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/base/test.
